details: At WebX 2026 in Tokyo, Bitmine Chairman Tom Lee announced the company's ambition to accumulate 5% of the total Ethereum supply before the ETH 2.0 era, having already secured 4.8%. The firm also launched MAVAN, a major single-node staking operator, and revealed a "Moonshot" investment plan for the ecosystem.
title: Bitmine Aims to Accumulate 5% of ETH Supply

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced its total holdings, including crypto, cash, and "moonshots," reached $11.3 billion as of July 12, 2026. This comprises 5.77 million ETH (with $9.0 billion staked on their MAVAN platform) and 206 Bitcoin.
title: Bitmine Holdings Reach $11.3B, 5.77M ETH & Major Staking Efforts

details: Ethereum's price dipped below $1,800 to approximately $1,775, influenced by renewed U.S.-Iran military escalation that is pushing investors out of risk assets. However, technical analysis indicates strong support near $1,750, with potential for a rally towards $2,140 if resistance at $1,825 is overcome.
title: Ethereum Price Slips Below $1,800 Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy Inc. increased its USD reserve by $450 million to $3 billion as of July 12, 2026, through selling MSTR shares. The company's Bitcoin holdings remained unchanged, indicating a shift from continuous accumulation to strengthening cash reserves for dividend payments and debt obligations.
title: Strategy Halts Bitcoin Buys, Boosts Cash Reserve to $3 Billion

details: Strategy's authorization of up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin sales and a share repurchase program, following $218 million in sales this year, underscores the vulnerability of "digital asset treasury" companies. These firms are highly sensitive to falling token prices, which have been exacerbated by geopolitical tensions and Federal Reserve policies.
title: Strategy Bitcoin Sales Highlight Woes of Crypto Hoarding Firms

details: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $90 million in inflows on Friday, marking a weekly net inflow of $197 million and breaking an eight-week outflow streak. Analysts like Standard Chartered and Bernstein predict Bitcoin could reach $100,000-$150,000. Technically, BTC/USD formed a double-bottom pattern, potentially targeting $67,135 then $70,000.
title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Rise, Analysts Maintain Bullish Outlook

details: The U.S. Senate is in a critical period to advance the CLARITY Act, a significant crypto market structure bill, before the August 7 congressional recess. Investor Kevin O'Leary suggests a 50-50 chance of it passing this year, cautioning that geopolitical tensions could impede progress despite strong industry advocacy for regulatory clarity.
title: US Senate Faces Crucial Week for CLARITY Act Crypto Bill

details: Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged increased government backing for Web3 initiatives, including funding and more favorable policies, during WebX 2026 in Tokyo. This commitment aims to foster blockchain development and adoption in the region.
title: Japan Pledges Stronger Web3 Support at WebX 2026

details: Bitcoin experienced a 20% decline in June, underscoring its close correlation with global macroeconomic trends and institutional investment flows. The cryptocurrency's future trajectory in 2026 will likely depend on renewed spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, progress on U.S. crypto regulation, and overall institutional demand.
title: Bitcoin's 20% June Plunge Linked to Macro Trends and ETF Outflows
